== Summary ==
A sleeved promotional card titled "•2026 World Championships", bearing the Minnesota Worlds 2026 / SWCCG Players Committee logo (Bloomington, MN, 23–25 October 2026). The text box is signed, top to bottom: Jeremy Christoffel (black ink; the surname ends in a cursive flourish), Marty McFly (green ink, as written), Will Tarbox (blue ink), and ZACH Stevenson (purple ink, as written).

* '''Source:''' SWCCG Discord, #retro-league-pc (28 October 2026)
* '''Date:''' posted 28 October 2026
